title: 纹唇恢复与日常护理，需要确认什么
title_en: Lip pigmentation: recovery and everyday care
intro: 扩唇和改乌唇做完后，都要经过表面结痂、脱痂返色到逐步稳定的过程。不要直接套用别人的第几天日程，按本次实际项目和自身状态来护理最稳妥。
intro_en: Both lip-contour and dark-lip work progress through initial saturation, surface flaking and gradual tone settling. Follow service-specific instructions rather than copying someone else’s day-by-day calendar.

sections.title: 头几天为什么看起来比预期深，怎么对待表皮结痂
sections.title_en: Why colour looks stronger initially and how to treat flaking skin
sections.description: 刚做完唇部项目时，表层色素与轻微收干表皮叠在一起，视觉上会比最终稳定后明显不少。接着进入结痂期（扩唇通常约3天恢复参考，改乌唇因底色与肤质差异不预设固定天数），脱痂期间最重要的是**绝对不要用手撕剥起皮**——必须让皮屑在滋润状态下自己掉干净，强行撕扯容易把下面刚挂住的色素一并带走或造成局部不匀。
sections.description_en: Fresh pigment plus initial dryness can make lips appear darker than their settled tone. As flaking begins—roughly three days as a guide for contour work, and individually variable for dark-lip correction—never pull or peel loose skin; letting it shed naturally with gentle moisture prevents patchy colour loss.

sections.title: 饮水、餐食、清洁与涂口红怎么逐步恢复
sections.title_en: Hydration, meals, cleansing and returning to lipstick
sections.description: 唇部日常高频接触水分与食物，操作完按老师当日示范的清洁、涂抹专用修复膏频率来做即可；刚做完阶段注意避免辛辣滚烫、过咸汤汁长时间浸泡表皮，洁面时避开强力磨砂或刺激性洗面奶扫过唇缘。至于什么时候可以恢复涂平时口红、润唇膏或剧烈运动出汗，应结合自己脱痂后的实际闭合情况向乐乐老师确认，不承诺做完马上毫无影响。
sections.description_en: Because lips face frequent contact with food and water, follow your aftercare ointment and gentle cleansing routine closely. Avoid piping-hot, very spicy or overly salty meals early on, and confirm with Lele when everyday lipstick or heavy workouts fit your actual healing stage.

sections.title: 返色期的明暗波动：为什么不能靠刚脱痂那天定结论
sections.title_en: Tone shifts after flaking: why day-four photos do not tell the whole story
sections.description: 刚脱痂的那两天，唇面往往处于角质更新过渡期，尤其改乌唇有时会显得略淡或局部色彩还在慢慢往外透。需要给皮肤足够的平稳时间再观察整体均匀度，不要刚脱痂几天觉得颜色清淡就焦虑或急于加做。
sections.description_en: Right after flaking finishes, lips often pass through a transitional muted phase—especially after dark-lip neutralisation—before true undertone balance becomes clear. Allow the full settling period before judging colour evenness.

sections.title: 复看补色与异常就医边界
sections.title_en: Review, one-year touch-up and medical precautions
sections.description: 所有唇部项目同样享有一年内免费补色，等颜色完全稳定后预约乐乐老师复看，如有局部边缘或转色不均处再针对性微调即可。如恢复期出现异常红肿持续不退、明显不适或个人体质特殊反应，请及时联系老师沟通，必要时尽早就医评估。
sections.description_en: All lip services include free touch-ups within one year once settled tone can be evaluated accurately. If persistent swelling, marked discomfort or unusual reactions appear during recovery, contact us immediately and consult a doctor if needed.
